customers_say: Customers find this water purification unit effective, with multi-stage purification that removes dissolved impurities and produces clean, pure water that tastes good. They appreciate its reliability, ease of use, and consider it a budget-friendly option. The service receives mixed reviews, with some praising the prompt service while others report very bad service.

reviews.author: Helloworld
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: The water purifier itself seems good, but I had a disappointing experience with the installation technician. The technician showed me a TDS meter reading of 900+ ppm and recommended that I purchase an additional pre-filter. I declined because a pre-filter is primarily meant to remove suspended particles/impurities and does not reduce TDS. What concerned me more was that the technician did not check the TDS of the purified water after installation. He also told me that the filter warranty was only 1 year. reviews.author: Balajee Bhardwaj
reviews.title: Good performance and great water taste
reviews.body: Good water purifier that gets the job done. The filtration works great—it brought down the TDS effectively, and the water tastes fresh and clean with no chemical odor. The build quality is compact and fits nicely in the kitchen without taking up too much space. Water wastage is also relatively lower compared to standard RO models. Deducting one star only because the dispensing flow could be slightly faster and installation took a couple of days to schedule. Overall, reliable value for money.

reviews.author: shajil parakkadavath
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: This purifier machine is good in budget and is running well now and the technician is charging extra ₹500 for TDS control.👍The first machine that arrived was faulty. I think it was repaired. After complaining to Call center , they gave me a new replacement machine.

reviews.author: Surendra
reviews.title: Water
reviews.body: The product was really good overall. However, I noticed that the water taste is slightly different compared to the water from a regular water filter. Because of this, I felt the taste was not quite up to the mark. Apart from that, the product is working really well and is in good condition.

reviews.author: lienlal thangjom
reviews.title: Go for it
reviews.body: Good product and reasonable price. Performance and system is also doing good. The quality of the water is also very good
